title: The biplanar clique blow-ups of the five-cycle

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
creators.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, Odisha 751030, India

description:
We prove that a clique blow-up C5[w] of the five-cycle is biplanar if and only if it has at most sixteen vertices and clique number at most eight. Consequently every biplanar clique blow-up of the five-cycle is 8-colourable, which answers Question 7.3 of A. Trivedi (doi:10.5281/zenodo.22074335) in the negative: no biplanar clique blow-up of the five-cycle is 9-chromatic. The 36 maximal biplanar cases have explicit pairs of plane straight-line drawings. The 26 minimal non-biplanar cases are refuted by a propositional encoding of biplanarity based on Schnyder's theorem, strengthened by a contraction argument for K9.

The archive contains the paper (PDF, LaTeX source with the figures as PNG, arXiv tarball), the dated priority check, the weight vectors, drawings and colourings, a Lean 4 development (the encoder, the finite reduction, the drawings and colourings by kernel evaluation, and a script that checks each LRAT certificate with the verified checker of the Lean standard library), and independent checks in C, C++, Bash, Python and Julia. The 26 trimmed LRAT certificates are attached to the GitHub release.
